purpose: Teach: オッサン/のら/てぇ/きき/フツー/おぉ/ムッ/ヘビー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんを「オッサン」って呼んじゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't call Dad an old man like that.
lines.style: Gentle correction, a little weary. Warm underneath—not scolding, more like she's reminding him of a boundary she has to keep reminding him about. Patient exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、のら猫を見つけたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I found a stray cat!
lines.style: Bright excitement, eager for her attention. Quick delivery, bouncing energy. The kind of pause after that expects her to care because of course she will.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ちょてぇ」って関西言葉を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me that Kansai word—what was it, "chotee"?
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning the memory over. Slow pace, slightly wondering tone. A small smile tucked in there, remembering the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの異変のききに気付いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I noticed something's been different with Dad lately.
lines.style: Careful, observant tone. Quiet confidence—he's not asking permission to have noticed. Steady pace, steady eye contact in his voice. Small but serious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、フツーの日常が一番幸せなのよ
lines.en: Sho, ordinary days are what make us happy.
lines.style: Soft certainty, almost to herself. Slow, deliberate. The warmth of someone who's learned this is true. No rush—the words land like they matter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが「おぉ、綺麗」と仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said something beautiful—he was looking at the view and just said, "Oh, how beautiful."
lines.style: Offering the moment to her like a gift. Warm, unhurried delivery. Respectful, like he's repeating something he knows she'll understand means something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがムッとされる事は滅多にないわよ
lines.en: Sho, it's rare for your dad to get upset about much of anything.
lines.style: Reflective, almost protective of Ryosuke in her tone. Measured, a little knowing. The pause before delivering this is like she's thinking aloud with him, not at him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがヘビーローテで聴く曲教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad showed me this song he listens to all the time—he really loves it.
lines.style: Eager to share, proud of the confidence. Warm pace, genuine. The kind of thing he's offering because she's someone who listens when he talks.
